title: Exponential Convergence of Deep Operator Networks for Elliptic Partial Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2112.08125v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We construct and analyze approximation rates of deep operator networks (ONets) between infinite-dimensional spaces that emulate with an exponential rate of convergence the coefficient-to-solution map of elliptic second-order partial differential equations. In particular, we consider problems set in $d$-dimensional periodic domains, $d=1, 2, \dots$, and with analytic right-hand sides and coefficients. Our analysis covers linear, elliptic second order divergence-form PDEs as, e.g., diffusion-reaction problems, parametric diffusion equations, and elliptic systems such as linear isotropic elastostatics in heterogeneous materials.   We leverage the exponential convergence of spectral collocation methods for boundary value problems whose solutions are analytic. translated_title: 深度算子网络对椭圆偏微分方程的指数收敛性
translated_abstract: 我们构建并分析了无限维空间之间深度算子网络（ONets）的逼近速率，这些网络能够以指数收敛速率模拟二阶椭圆偏微分方程的系数到解的映射。特别地，我们考虑设置在 $d$ 维周期区域（$d=1, 2, \dots$）上、且右端项和系数均为解析函数的问题。我们的分析涵盖线性、二阶椭圆散度形式的偏微分方程，例如扩散-反应问题、参数化扩散方程，以及椭圆方程组，如非均质材料中的线性各向同性弹性静力学问题。我们利用了谱配置方法对于解为解析函数的边值问题所具有的指数收敛性。在当前的周期与解析设定下，这一性质可由经典的椭圆正则性理论得出。在 [Chen and Chen, 1993] 等提出的 ONet 分支与主干网络构造框架中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了深度算子网络（ONet）能够以指数收敛速率逼近具有解析系数的二阶椭圆偏微分方程在周期区域上的系数到解映射，其分析涵盖扩散-反应、参数化扩散及非均质材料弹性静力学等线性椭圆问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that deep operator networks (ONets) can emulate the coefficient-to-solution map of linear second-order elliptic PDEs with analytic coefficients on periodic domains at an exponential convergence rate, covering problems such as diffusion-reaction, parametric diffusion, and elastostatics in heterogeneous materials.
